problem.statement: DeepGEMM -- FP8 GEMM with Fine-Grained Scaling -- FP8 Accumulation with Nc=128 CUDA Core Promotion

payload.technique: FP8 Accumulation with Nc=128 CUDA Core Promotion
payload.what: On Hopper, the Tensor Core accumulator has limited precision (~FP22, not true FP32). DeepGEMM mitigates this by promoting partial sums to a separate FP32 accumulator on CUDA Cores every Nc=128 columns (4 consecutive WGMMA operations).
payload.when: On Hopper, the Tensor Core accumulator has limited precision (~FP22, not true FP32).
